Precondition: A released die-cast LOT sits in this Trim area's IN queue; terminal bound to the Trim shop
Step: Scan the LTT barcode of an arriving LOT (or pick it from the FIFO queue)
Expected Result: A LotMovement is recorded to the Trim Shop Area; the LOT is checked in at Trim at area resolution (no line/cell tracking)

Precondition: Trim terminal bound to its shop zone
Expected Result: Queue lists die-cast LOTs whose next pending route step is Trim, scoped to the terminal's Trim zone, ordered FIFO by arrival

Precondition: A LOT is checked in at this Trim shop
Step: Enter the LOT's shot count and trigger Trim OUT
Expected Result: In one transaction a closing Workorder.ProductionEvent checkpoint is written and the WHOLE LOT is moved into this shop's local Trim Storage (TRIM{N}-STORE); the LOT stays open, no split, no child LOTs
Notes: Destination picker retired 2026-07-23 - Trim OUT always deposits to the shop's local Trim Storage; Machining IN assigns the line later

Precondition: Recording Trim OUT with sprue/yield scrap
Step: Enter a scrap count and submit
Expected Result: Scrap decrements the LOT: PieceCount is reduced by the scrap count so the LOT arrives in Trim Storage with its real remaining quantity

Precondition: A LOT with a known PieceCount
Step: Enter shot + scrap counts whose combined sum exceeds the LOT's PieceCount and submit
Expected Result: System rejects with a clear message - combined shot+scrap can never exceed PieceCount

Precondition: A LOT already Trim-OUT'd (now in Trim Storage)
Step: Attempt a second Trim OUT of the same LOT from the Trim station
Expected Result: System rejects - the LOT is no longer at this Trim station (double-checkout block)
